title: The Missing Brigadeiro
summary: A tray of 40 brigadeiros vanished from a birthday party minutes before the cake.

suspects.name: Dona Neide
suspects.note: Baked the brigadeiros and counted them twice.

suspects.name: Tio Juca
suspects.note: Was seen near the kitchen holding a napkin.

suspects.name: Paçoca the cat
suspects.note: Chocolate sprinkles found on its whiskers.

evidence: Empty tray found under the sofa.
Sprinkle trail leading to the laundry room.

title: The Vanishing Bilhete Único
summary: A transit card disappeared between two turnstiles at Sé station.

suspects.name: Station guard Rui
suspects.note: On shift, but on a coffee break.

suspects.name: Street vendor Lia
suspects.note: Sells card holders right next to the gate.

suspects.name: Commuter Beto
suspects.note: Late for work and in a hurry.

evidence: Camera 4 was pointed at the ceiling.

title: The Midnight Samba
summary: Neighbors report a samba drum playing at 3 a.m. from an apartment that is empty.

suspects.name: Smart speaker
suspects.note: Left on shuffle by the previous tenant.

title: The Silent Pandeiro
summary: A pandeiro stopped jingling the night before the show.
